name: manual_42757a
claim: Keep operator authentication, exact-head acceptance, independent-review policy, platform qualification and activation as separate evidence. A fresh operator-performed GitHub login proves procedural account control, not review quality; operator-only C3d does not waive the distinct Release R6 gate or authorize serving.

decisions.notes: Direct November6 operator decisions allow operator-only C3d and future configurable independent review while retaining exact-final-head acceptance, separate Windows qualification and dark-by-default serving.

rationale: Direct November6 operator decisions allow operator-only C3d and future configurable independent review while retaining exact-final-head acceptance, separate Windows qualification and dark-by-default serving.
